482.text: [ACT] _F_, remove a vibe counter from this Character: Choose a Character and boost its vibe by 3 for the rest of this Cycle.

484.text: Choose a Character. For the rest of this Cycle, boost its vibe by 2 and if it wins Vibe Check, draw a card.

486.text: When this Character is iced, choose a Character and put 3 vibe counters on it.

487.text: Each player gives their huddle to the player on their right.

488.text: Choose a Character. Its controller draws a card. Ice that Character.

489.text: Whenever this Character produces Pudge, choose another Character in your huddle and return it to its owner's hand.

490.text: Choose a Character. If it's Green, put 6 vibe counters on it. Otherwise, ice it.

493.text: When this Character enters the huddle, choose a non-Silly Character in your huddle and ice it. At the start of the next Cycle, return it from ice to its owner's huddle.

505.text: Whenever you ice any number of cards from your hand, put that many vibe counters on this Character.

510.text: [ACT] _F_: The next time this Character would be iced this Cycle, it isn't.

511.text: When this Character enters the huddle, if another Character entered your huddle this Cycle, this Character enters with 3 vibe counters.

512.text: Whenever you ice any number of cards from your hand, you get a Fishsicle.

513.text: Whenever any number of Characters in your huddle are iced, put a vibe counter on this Character. At the start of Action Time, choose a Character. Boost its vibe by this Character's vibe for the rest of this Cycle.

515.text: At the end of Action Time, if you have the Baron, put a vibe counter on each Character in your huddle.

530.text: As an additional cost to play this Action, reveal another Red Action card from your hand. Choose a Character and ice it.

568.text: Choose a Fit and choose a Character not wearing it. Outfit that Character. Draw a card.

569.text: Whenever any number of Characters in your huddle are iced, put a vibe counter on this Character.

571.text: Choose up to two Green Characters in your huddle and put a vibe counter on each of them. Whenever any number of vibe counters are removed from a Green Character in your huddle, if this card is in your ice, return it to your hand.

572.text: Whenever a Character in your huddle is outfitted, put a vibe counter on that Character.

573.text: Each player ices a Rod they control and draws a card. Each player may pick a card in their hand and put it face-down as a Rod.

574.text: When this Character enters the huddle, put a vibe counter on it for each other Character in your huddle.

576.text: Choose a Character to wear this Fit. The Character wearing this gains the ability "[ACT] _F_: Choose a Character. Move all vibe counters from this Character onto the chosen Character".

577.text: As an additional cost to play this Action, ice any number of Characters in your huddle. If you iced two or more Characters this way, draw two cards.

580.text: Whenever another Character enters your huddle, you may pay _T__T__T_. If you do, put 4 vibe counters on it.

581.text: Whenever this Character wins Vibe Check, look at the top card of your deck. If it's a Fit card, you may reveal it and draw it. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

582.text: Choose two Characters and put 2 vibe counters on each of them. Draw a card.

591.text: This Action costs one less _R_ to play for each Red Action you've played this Cycle. Choose a Rod, Relic, or Character and ice it.

592.text: [ACT] _F_: Choose a Fit and choose a Character not wearing it. Outfit that Character.

593.text: Choose a Character to wear this Fit. The Character wearing this can produce _P_.

594.text: The next time a Character would be put into ice from play this Cycle, return it from ice to its owner’s huddle. If multiple are put into ice at the same time, you pick.

596.text: [ACT] _F_: Choose a Character in your huddle and ice it. You get two Fishsicles.

597.text: Whenever a Fit you control is iced from play, put it on top of your deck.

598.text: Whenever this Character produces Pudge, choose a Green Character and put a vibe counter on it.

599.text: Whenever a Character in your opponent's huddle is iced, if it's wearing a Fit you own, return that Fit to your hand.

603.text: Playable from ice by icing a Character in your huddle in addition to paying this card's Fish cost.

607.text: When you ice the first card from your hand each Cycle, if this Character is flopped, draw a card. Whenever another Relaxing Birb enters a huddle, ice this Character.

610.text: This Character doesn't participate in Vibe Check unless it has 17 or more vibe counters on it. Whenever you draw any number of cards, put that many vibe counters on this Character.

611.text: Whenever another Green Character enters your huddle, put a vibe counter on it.

613.name: Sunday Afternoon
613.text: Choose a Character. If its vibe is less than its Fish cost, ice it.

615.text: Choose any number of Characters and put 2 vibe counters on each of them.

619.text: When this Character enters the huddle, if your huddle has more Characters than your opponent's huddle, put 2 vibe counters on this Character.

620.text: Choose a Character to wear this Fit. The Character wearing this gains the ability "Whenever you play an Action, flop all Characters in your huddle with vibe 10 or greater".

635.text: Choose a Character to wear this Fit. The Character wearing this gets +20 vibe.

621.text: Whenever a Character is chosen by anything, put a vibe counter on that Character.
